title: Normalized tensor structures on existing pro-etale section-module functors
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. On each small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use the pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and the fixed section equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use the actual section-ring coefficient map, module direct image, tensor-formula inverse image, specified adjunction, open extension and geometric composition maps already constructed in [def-pd-section-module-operations-data]. For the relative tensors [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor], normalize the internal and section-module direct-image lax tensor structures by the local pure-tensor pairing. Their uniquely determined unit maps are the regular-module coefficient maps. Define inverse-image oplax structures as their adjunction mates, with their strong structures supplied by the invertibility of the local scalar-extension tensor and unit formulas. Internal pullback preserves flat modules. Use the unique local-pure-tensor ordinary tensor comparison and the unique scalar-section regular-unit comparison on the local pure tensors of [def-pd-section-module-operations-data]. Define the signed direct-sum total comparison by its value on every summand of fixed total degree. The exactness and additivity prerequisites of the specified functors are named construction lemmas, including exact inverse image, exact open extension, and preservation of homology by the section equivalence. The internal functors and open extension are those of [def-sfb-module-upper-star], [def-sfb-module-lower-star], and [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek].

proof.text: Keep the operations-data aliases. Use the existing proved comparison_tensorIso and comparison_unitIso constructions and their pure-tensor and regular-unit equations. The internal-tensor hom extensionality theorem proves uniqueness of tensor comparisons, and scalar sections determine the regular-unit comparison.

Apply the ringed-direct-image pairing lemma with $v(U)=U\times_YX$ and the retained coefficient map. Its scalar action is precisely the retained direct image, so it supplies the unique section-module lax structure, including the coefficient-map unit. Record this specialized obligation as pushNormalized_existsUnique.

Use pull_delta_isIso for the tensor component. For the unit, normalization fixes the direct-image coefficient unit; adjunction uniqueness identifies its mate with Mathlib’s canonical regular-unit map, invertible because site base change is final. Convert the specified invertible oplax maps to a strong structure.

Use the existing normalized right-adjoint pairing of the strong internal pullback from TraceBaseChangeFirst. Its lower_mu_pi equation gives the pure-tensor formula, and local pure tensors determine its tensor maps and hence its unit. Equality of normalized lax structures and the lax/oplax adjunction equivalence identify the retained internal pullback mates with the existing strong structure, so both are invertible. Apply the existing strong conversion without changing its mate maps.

source.place: Tags 03D7, 03EK and 03EL; canonical internal adjunction pairing and local tensor generation

proof.text: Exact internal pullback and exact open extension transport through the additive exact section equivalences. Kernels, images and cokernels then transport, hence so does homology. Direct image adds maps sectionwise, hence preserves sums and zero; pullback and extension are additive through these identifications. Tensor maps with a zero factor vanish on pure tensors and hence vanish by bilinear universality, also internally by faithfulness.

The coefficient isomorphism identifies internal scalar extension with restriction along $\alpha_f^{-1}$. Apply inverse-image-module-flat to this inverse and conjugate by extension-along-iso. Isomorphic tensor functors have the same exactness tests, so the actual internal pullback preserves flat modules.

Use the existing signed-total comparison constructed from the natural ordinary tensor comparisons. Prove uniqueness abstractly: a fully faithful essentially surjective functor transports the jointly epimorphic total-complex summand inclusions. Hence summand equations determine the map in each degree. Specialize to the section equivalence and rewrite its tensor comparison using the unique pure-tensor normalization.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NF-a0c6e6306 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: PASS, no fixes written. The delivery does what the human's 2026-10-24 repair note asks. It changes only the item's proof, proof_deps and split_report. Steps 1 and 4-7 are byte-identical to the base copy. Steps 2 and 3 keep their old text word for word and add one 'Record…' sentence each, plus citations of the three theorem nodes. Those nodes were registered on the base by maintenance commit 2e8ce1f, with created.item set to this item. The statement, stmt_deps and lean of the item are unchanged, and no argument was dropped or shortened. The three statements match the Lean signatures in ProEtaleSectionModuleFunctors.lean at :532 (∃! normalized LaxMonoidal), :552 (IsIso δ of pullOplax = leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal) and :560 (IsIso η). All three are statement-only and unsplit, with 5 searches each, and their closures do not contain the item (no cycle). All three are true. Push: the balanced pairing through c sheafifies, uniqueness follows from the 03EK bilinear property, and the left unit law at R_X with x=1 forces e=c. Delta is Stacks 03EL and also follows from lem-pd-ringed-tensor-adjunction-mate, whose premises are supplied by the canonical-unit lemma and the invertible coefficient map. Eta is R_X⊗R_Y→R_X with inverse s↦s⊗1. They hold for f=id, the zero ring and empty X. The Stacks sources 03EK (sites-modules.tex:3551), 03EL (:3649) and 03D7 were read; no SGA is used. The nodes specialize lem-pd-ringed-direct-image-pairing-lax and lem-pd-ringed-tensor-adjunction-mate; the human's order explicitly requires one node per Lean theorem, so I accept that. They are not duplicates of ordinary-oplax-normalization (internal pullback, and it depends on the parent), independent-ringed-tensorator-existence (existence only) or canonical-module-adjunction-unit (unit formula only). Batch-5: I accept all three citations. They are general module facts (lax direct image, f^*(M⊗N)≅f^*M⊗f^*N, f^*O≅O), not steps of the Poincaré duality or trace formula proofs. The item lies under the assumption leaves' own statements, through sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek → … → lem-sfb-internal-scalar-projection-mate. The six tool_uses are accepted. Advisory: the delta and eta statements describe P's normalized structure without citing the push theorem, which is correct since a theorem must not be a stmt_dep; their future proofs should cite the push node.
